newsitem.title: JAPAN: Biwako Bank shares down in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Biwako Bank shares down in morning trade.

text.p: Shares in Biwako Bank Ltd were down on Wednesday amid thin trade, brokers said.
There were vague market rumours that the bank was planning to hold a news conference on its financial condition, but a bank official said there were no such plans.
As of 0140 GMT, the shares were at 498 yen. It was last traded on Monday at 549 yen.
On Monday, the bank announced that it had raised its earnings forecast for the six months to September 30, 1996.
It raised its parent current profit forecast to 1.39 billion yen from its previous forecast of 600 million yen, due to an increase in interest income and cost-cutting efforts.
Biwako Bank is a small regional bank in western Japan.
